newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa shares end mixed, Gencor active.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa shares end mixed, Gencor active.

text.p: 1422 GMT - South African gold shares finish weaker after bullion price struggles to escape softer levels. Industrials end firm after a slow start with Gencor seeing a large bookover of 5 million shares which take up 17 percent of total market volumes.
* Gencor ends 15 cents up at 19.95 rand in a volume worth nearly 86 million rand.

* Dealers say sentiment in industrials initially hit by poor gold price but that index recovered around noon on bargain hunting and was buoyed by prevailing generally positive outlook for the local economy.
* Some off-shore buying and volumes moderate at 819 million rands worth with a few big deals in some shares.
* Profurn saw around five million shares change hands in a foreign purchase worth over 11 million rand. Profurn ended up four cents to 200 cents.
* The overall index up 10.1 points to 7,390.7, industrials gain 43.2 points to 8,885.7 and golds lose 23.3 points to 976.3.
